guides.title: Conquest Mid Casuals
guides.notes: With Anubis having not much mobility, i personally started building Doom Orb on him along with everything else i have listed and i honestly have been slaying mid lane and dominating end games with easily 20-30 kills. After been using this for weeks i still havent came across any other mid laners who made me struggle. If you like Anubis you should definitely try this, even if you are just trying a new god i would recommend this a lot.
